literal: Else I, how exist I, alas! With him I, experienced days, to remember, exist I.
translation: How else could I stay alive, alas? I survive only by remembering the days I shared with him.
modern: நான் வேறு எப்படி உயிர் வாழ்வேன்? அவருடன் நான் கூடி மகிழ்ந்த நாட்களை நினைத்துப் பார்ப்பதால்தான் நான் இன்னும் உயிரோடு இருக்கிறேன்.
explanation: The speaker expresses her deep sorrow and longing for her absent lover. She wonders how she could possibly remain alive while enduring the pain of separation. She reveals that her only means of survival is the constant memory of the joyful days they spent together. The word 'உள்ள' (to remember) highlights that her existence now depends entirely on reliving those past moments in her mind.
